intake.current_process_summary: Owner checks WhatsApp ad hoc; website form emails often sit unread overnight.
intake.escalation_rules: If no owner reply within 4 business hours, operator pings named approver once; after-hours alerts fire but reply expected next morning.
intake.approved_response_rules: Acknowledge enquiry, confirm interest area, offer viewing window. No pricing guarantees. No medical/legal advice.
intake.reporting_requirements: Daily summary at 17:00 local; pilot metric = every new enquiry on board within 15 minutes.
client_responsibilities: Provide one named leaky enquiry source and keep it available during the pilot window
Name one working WhatsApp and one working email that the owner monitors
Reply to customers — CorpFlow surfaces and follows the agreed process; it does not auto-reply as the business
Provide feedback on preview/verification within the agreed review cadence
Escalate blockers (access, forwarding, owner availability) within one business day
exclusions: No WhatsApp/email/SMS automated runtime without separate messaging-runtime authorisation
No second lead source during the 48-hour setup window
No full CRM migration or historical database import
No passwords, OTPs, card data, or government ID collected in chat or tickets
No client_production deploy or DNS change as part of Lead Rescue wedge pilot
acceptance_measures: One lead source connected and a marked test enquiry visible in the lead log
Operator alert path verified on the test enquiry (operator-side)
Buyer can receive the agreed daily summary channel(s)
Lead stages and escalation rules documented and usable on the pilot board
Handover note delivered with support boundary and monitoring window dates
intake.review_cadence: Preview feedback within 2 business days; day-1 / day-3 / day-7 during monitoring.
